bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · back above the 10-day
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 重回 10 日均线上方

read.en: Nvidia rose 0.9% on Oct 27 to $217.94, trading between $215.53 and $219.19. It is above the falling 5-day ($215.8), 10-day ($216.5) and 100-day ($214.4) averages and the rising 200-day ($204.0), and below the falling 30-day ($224.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($226.41), and RSI is 46.
read.zh: 英伟达 10月27日上涨 0.9%，收于 $217.94，盘中区间 $215.53–219.19。股价位于下行的 5 日（$215.8）、10 日（$216.5）和 100 日均线（$214.4）以及上行的 200 日均线（$204.0）上方，低于下行的 30 日均线（$224.4）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$226.41），RSI 为 46。

read.en: The close reclaimed the 10-day ($216.5); the $219.2 high poked above the $218.9 Oct 22 high but the close stayed under it. Resistance is $218.9–219.2, then $222.2 (Oct 21 high) and $224.4–226.4 (30-day, SAR). Support is $214.4–216.5 (5, 10 and 100-day), then $210.2–211.3 (Oct 22–23 lows) and $207.3–208.9. A close above $219.2 would target $222–224; a close below $214.4 would open $210–211.
